title: Pyne Pod Strawberry Watermelon Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Strawberry Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid combines two of vaping’s most beloved fruits into a balanced, everyday blend. The sweet, rich notes of fresh Strawberries form a smooth foundation, while the light, crisp, and slightly cooling taste of Watermelon adds a refreshing lift. This combination ensures a consistent, well-rounded fruit profile that tastes familiar yet distinct, making it an excellent all-day vape for those who prefer straightforward fruit flavours. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the classic pairing of Strawberry Watermelon, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the zesty Lemon Lime or the sunny Summer Punch.
